title: Hatsune Miku — Watchful Seniors〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(Every time I play this song...
It feels like there's just something different about it.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (It's like Ichika said... When I play it, my heart...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: H-How long have you all been there?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
We came in just now.
But it looked like you were trying to focus, Miku-P, so we figured we should keep quiet!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We were wondering where you'd gone after Ichika and the girls left. So you've been practicing here the whole time?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: P-Practicing? Not really. Just playing something I like...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Also, you really should've said something. I thought my heart was going to stop.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Haha. Sorry about that.
We didn't want to interrupt since you had a good sound going and seemed to be really enjoying yourself.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, I wanted to hear more!
You were playing the song Ichi wrote just now, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The sound you were producing felt very happy. More than usual...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, you seemed to have a lot of fun playing it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Does this song have a special place in your heart, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: When you put it that way, I can't help but feel embarrassed...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Still, you're right...
Although I didn't directly do anything for Ichika when she was writing this song...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
And...
Miku, when I heard you sing that melody for the first time, I...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I thought our hearts were in perfect sync.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The way I wanted to show how much I want to be there for everyone and how brilliant their smiles are... Miku, through your singing voice, you said that you understand.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That made me so happy.
Which is why when I finished writing my song earlier...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It felt like we made it together...
I didn't create it alone. This song felt like our song.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It made me so happy when she said that “we made it together”.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I knew that Ichika liked the Miku from her world... But I wasn't expecting her to say that about her very first song that meant so much to her.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Which is why this song is also precious to me... Whenever I play it, I can feel my heart syncing perfectly with hers, just like she said.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I can feel her honest personality flowing through me.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
It really is a wonderful song...
The others have mentioned this before, but I hope this reaches the ears of more and more people.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
But it is!
The video for this song's already gotten 500 views!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
The one with Miku singing has 1,600, right?
That's pretty incredible.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
However, I agree with Luka...
I too hope more people listen to it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Me too.
No, I don't hope... I'm sure it'll reach them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Because Ichika's song is just that good!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hehe♪
So it really did put a big smile on your face, Miku-P♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Well, of course...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, also...
It's had a fairly significant effect on us...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It has. Not only does it resonate with me each time, I seem to learn something new with every listen.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Because Ichika poured her heart and soul into this wonderful song.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: All of you...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, let's show just how much this song means to us by singing it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay...!
